overview.text: Today's AI developments highlight significant progress across agentic systems, multimodal models, and practical enterprise deployments. ToolSpace introduces tool-centric environment synthesis for long-horizon agents composing diverse services into executable workflows, while VidUEU-Agent tackles instruction data scarcity for multimodal understanding and editing tasks. In computer vision, FlowTranslator enables training-free in-image machine translation through flow-based editing, bypassing the need for massive paired training sets. Simultaneously, Recursa addresses how foundation models can tackle unfamiliar domains without relying on large expert-created training datasets. In model releases, SenseNova-Loop-9B-Preview emerges as a new multimodal language model tailored for long-context and agentic workflows handling text and images. Finally, enterprises continue applying frontier models to real-world operations, with companies like Cisco leveraging OpenAI models to enhance enterprise security and defend networks at machine speed.

entries.title: ToolSpace: Scaling Tool-Centric Environment Synthesis for Long-Horizon Agents
entries.summary: Large language models are deployed as long-horizon agents that compose diverse tools across MCP services into executable workflows. Existing MCP environment-scaling methods are data-centric: they first synthesize a database and scenario, then derive tools and tasks from them.
entries.why: This scales tool-centric environment synthesis for long-horizon agents composing diverse tools across services.

entries.title: VidUEU-Agent: A Data-Curation Agent for Multimodal Understanding, Editing, and Unified Tasks
entries.summary: The advancement of multimodal learning is heavily constrained by the scarcity and high annotation cost of high-quality instruction data.
entries.why: It addresses multimodal learning constraints by improving data curation for understanding and editing tasks.

entries.title: FlowTranslator: Training-Free In-Image Machine Translation with Flow-Based Editing
entries.summary: In-image machine translation (IIMT) replaces text in an image with its translation while preserving the surrounding visual context. Existing task-specific models achieve convincing performance but require massive paired training images before and after translation.
entries.why: It enables training-free in-image machine translation while preserving surrounding visual context without paired datasets.

entries.title: Recursa: Toward Recursively Self-Improving Foundation Model Systems
entries.summary: Foundation models in changing environments can encounter unfamiliar domain knowledge that their original training did not cover. However, new domains rarely provide large amounts of expert-created training data or reliable supervisory signals for further training.
entries.why: It helps foundation models adapt to unfamiliar domains lacking large amounts of expert training data.

entries.title: Mage-VL-Cowork: A Full Training Recipe to Learn Hybrid Computer Use From Evolved Harnesses
entries.summary: Effective computer-use agents (CUAs) should seamlessly combine visual GUI interaction with code and terminal execution within a single policy.
entries.why: It provides a training recipe to combine visual GUI interaction with code and terminal execution.

entries.title: LOLPlay: Benchmarking Real-Time Visual Agents in League of Legends
entries.summary: Visual agents need to coordinate reasoning and action while their environment evolves during inference. We introduce LOLPlay, a benchmark in native League of Legends with 36 champion-specific tasks spanning resource management, combat, cooperation, and objectives.
entries.why: It introduces a benchmark for evaluating real-time visual agents in dynamic gaming environments.

entries.title: Route Anything: A Study of Model and Policy Routing for General-Purpose AI Systems
entries.summary: Artificial general intelligence (AGI) requires a method that can understand, generate, reason, and act across diverse domains and modalities.
entries.why: It studies model and policy routing for general-purpose artificial intelligence systems across modalities.

entries.title: sensenova/SenseNova-Loop-9B-Preview · Hugging Face
entries.summary: Overview SenseNova-Loop-9B-Preview is a multimodal language model developed for long-context and agentic workflows. It accepts text and images and generates text for applications that combine document understanding, coding, and interaction with external tools.
entries.why: It offers a new multimodal language model specifically developed for long-context and agentic workflows.

entries.title: abenzerps/Qwen-Image-2.1-Turbo-Quantized
entries.why: It provides a quantized text-to-image model variant for efficient generation tasks.

entries.title: LiquidAI/LFM3-1.7B
entries.why: It delivers a compact text-generation model for transformer-based application pipelines.

entries.title: Heimstaden is changing residential real estate management with AI
entries.summary: Discover how Heimstaden uses OpenAI’s ChatGPT Enterprise and Codex to transform property management, cut costs, and empower employees across Europe.
entries.why: It demonstrates how enterprise adoption of chat and code models transforms property management operations.

entries.title: How Cisco defends at machine speed with OpenAI
entries.summary: Cisco combines network intelligence with OpenAI models to strengthen enterprise security. Learn how it is building more adaptive defenses.
entries.why: It shows how network intelligence combines with language models to build adaptive enterprise security defenses.

entries.title: Desiderata for the Theory of Agents
entries.summary: TLDR: I give informal conceptual desiderata for the theory of agents we need to solve ASI alignment, and show a few examples of how existing theories fall short of these desiderata. A Theory of What?
entries.why: It outlines informal conceptual desiderata for the theory of agents needed to solve alignment.

entries.title: I discovered a sound that leaks your exact location (and it's everywhere) - YouTube
entries.summary: I discovered a sound that leaks your exact location (and it's everywhere) - YouTube Genius piece of OSINT by Colsto, who demonstrates how you can take almost imperceptible background noise of planes from a video soundtrack, figure out their Doppler curves, then cross reference…
entries.why: It demonstrates an OSINT technique extracting exact locations from ambient audio Doppler curves.

entries.title: Building AI for Lawyers - Jacob Lauritzen, CTO of Legora
entries.summary: Evals without traces, million-cell tabular reviews, and cracks in the billable hour as a business model
entries.why: It explores practical engineering challenges in building artificial intelligence systems for legal workflows.
